coverage.method: Fresh bounded story-specific writers read current/original/meaningful-alternative and connected sources before revision, reread/compared afterward; independent native image review and separate fresh complete rendered reading for every story.
coverage.scope_note: Earlier collection-wide reading evidence is preserved separately below; current per-story comedy and reading records govern this expanded commission.

checks: 70 current story hashes match full reading review pins
Every selected image hash appears in its direct independent visual record and fresh complete-reading record
Embedded image set equals current selected set for each story
At least two unique images in every primary before any alternative section
All material episode and expanded master findings closed
Approval unapproved and publication not_published retained
limits: These integrity checks bind the independently reviewed artifacts; they do not themselves assess humor, visual quality or owner approval.
